review_question: Among singleton pregnancies with prior spontaneous preterm birth and ultrasound-indicated cerclage, does adjuvant 17-hydroxyprogesterone caproate alter preterm birth before 35 weeks compared with cerclage alone?

pico.population: Singleton pregnancy with prior spontaneous preterm birth and ultrasound-indicated cerclage

targets.comparison: Adjuvant 17-hydroxyprogesterone caproate plus ultrasound-indicated cerclage versus ultrasound-indicated cerclage alone
targets.population_or_subgroup: Singleton pregnancy with prior spontaneous preterm birth and ultrasound-indicated cerclage

timepoint_policy.rule: Extract the source-reported delivery threshold and preserve whether it denotes birth before or at/after the threshold.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Capture source-reported arm-level binary outcomes relevant to the declared pregnancy and cerclage context; preserve outcome direction and subgroup scope.

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract event counts and denominators in both exposure groups, source outcome definition, population or subgroup, delivery threshold, and verified primary-source locator. Do not copy event counts or effects from a review forest plot.

output_contract.effect_unit: one source-reported arm-level binary pregnancy outcome
